source_truth.primary_source: U.S. EPA Office of Water — WATERS Services REST API
source_truth.geofabric: NHDPlus V2.1 (Puerto Rico = VPU 21; Vogel/VPUAttribute extensions unavailable -> attribute_coverage stamped partial)

real_data_sources.aee_incidents: SuperSonicHub1/luma-energy-outages outages_by_town.json (CC0; modern per-municipio realization of the legacy AEEIncidents town/area model after PREPA->LUMA 2021). NOTE: committed data remains the reproducible 2025-03-03 point-in-time snapshot at tier T2/needs_review. scripts/fetch_luma_live.py provides an optional direct MiLUMA runtime path but the source remains WAF/permission gated.
real_data_sources.luma_regional_status: data/luma_status_snapshots.jsonl append-only runtime history from MiLUMA /outage/regionsWithoutService via scripts/fetch_luma_live.py + scripts/ingest_luma_status.py. RAW_UNFROZEN/T2: exact raw payload is preserved with retrieval timestamp + canonical-payload SHA-256; regional aggregates are never expanded into municipio events or certified restoration intervals.
real_data_sources.luma_regional_status_changes: data/luma_status_changes.jsonl conservative adjacent-snapshot derivative from scripts/derive_luma_status_changes.py. Hash equality/difference certifies SOURCE_STATE_UNCHANGED|SOURCE_STATE_CHANGE only. restoration_state and outage_lifecycle_state remain UNRESOLVED because LUMA ERP documentation permits OMS/web interface suppression and manual restoration updates during major events.
real_data_sources.pr_municipios_geo: data/geo/pr_municipios.json (Census Gazetteer centroids: normalization + spatial joins) + data/geo/pr_municipios.geojson (78 municipio polygons) + data/geo/pr_barrios.geojson (901 barrios, each linked to its municipio) for the map layer; U.S. Census cartographic boundaries (public domain), WGS84
real_data_sources.neon_availability: data/neon_availability.jsonl + data/neon_publication_events.jsonl (NSF NEON API v0, data.neonscience.org/api/v0/sites; Domain D04 'Atlantic Neotropical' = the 4 Puerto Rico sites CUPE/GUAN/GUIL/LAJA). Keyless T1 federal feed: per-site/product availableMonths state and the publication-change delta derived from it (scripts/ingest_neon.py). Licence CC BY 4.0 per NEON's data policy (neonscience.org/data-samples/data-policies-citation-guidelines).
real_data_sources.neon_readings: data/neon_readings.jsonl (NSF NEON API v0 /data/{product}/{site}/{month}; scripts/ingest_neon_products.py). Stream discharge, surface-water elevation and surface-water chemistry at CUPE/GUIL as monitoring_reading rows, daily-aggregated with NEON QA-flagged records dropped. NOTE: this endpoint is token-gated (see waf_blocked_sources) and the live download path is UNVERIFIED — built and tested against synthetic fixtures only, pending a NEON_API_TOKEN. Runtime-only file, not committed, like every other time-series reading source.

centinelas_pr_only_gaps: PREB (Puerto Rico Energy Bureau) regulatory filings: document-based portal, no structured API — centinelas-pr monitors filings and sends signals via ingest_news_event.py until PREB publishes a machine-readable feed

AAA/PRASA boil-water notices: the AAA portal is a Webflow marketing site with no public API — SDWIS T1 microbial violations (ingest_sdwis_violations.py) are the authoritative regulatory boil-water signal; individual AAA press-release notices route through centinelas-pr -> ingest_news_event.py at T3
waf_blocked_sources: MiLUMA / api.miluma.lumapr.com: Incapsula WAF returns HTTP 403 to plain clients; fetch_luma_live.py attempts a browser User-Agent workaround but success is not guaranteed; activate via refresh.py --all (optional step, warns and continues on WAF failure); a formal PREB/LUMA data-sharing arrangement is the recommended path to T1 electric outage attribution

NEON /api/v0/data/{product}/{site}/{month} (data.neonscience.org): returns HTTP 403 {'error':{'status':403,'detail':'Access Denied'}} to anonymous callers — NEON's own gateway, verified against sibling paths on the same host that answer 200. Requires a free NEON API token (data.neonscience.org/myaccount) sent as the X-API-Token header; note that an INVALID token also yields 403, even on endpoints that are open anonymously. Activate via refresh.py --weekly/--all (optional step: scripts/ingest_neon_products.py prints a skip notice and exits 0 when the token is absent). NEON *metadata* — sites, products, releases, and the availableMonths publication signal this producer's alerts are built on — needs no credential and is unaffected.
